What's the difference between monthly and yearly cashback?
Monthly cashback is calculated per statement cycle and paid into your credit card account every month.
Yearly cashback is calculated annually and is paid into your credit card account every 12 months.
Which credit cards give me cashback?
HSBC offers 2 credit cards which allow you to earn cashback:

The Live+ Credit Card, which lets you earn 6% (up to AED 200) on dining, 5% (up to AED 200) on fuel and 2% (up to AED 200 each) on groceries and entertainment per statement cycle when you spend at least AED 3,000 a month.
The Cash+ Credit Card, which lets you earn 1% cashback on all your purchases, with no minimum spend or earning caps.
